summary: This is a prospectus supplement (424B5) filed by Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) relating to the offering of Leveraged Index Return Notes (LIRNs), unsecured senior notes linked to one or more equity indices or ETFs. The filing describes the general terms, risks, and mechanics of the notes, including their leveraged return, downside protection features, and potential automatic call. No specific deal terms are provided; these will be per-issuance in a term sheet. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and does not involve any special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign.
